# Rana's journal (p15) — BodyTracker

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Setup was easy: height 165, age 23, weight 48.6 (this morning's scale), female, lightly active, "yes" to eating the same for 2+ weeks. My weight got saved as today's weigh-in automatically, nice.
- There was NO goal/goal weight question in setup. I went looking.
- Nutrition ⚙: "Your BMI is below 18.5, so weight-loss targets are turned off. Maintenance is shown instead." The **Lose** button is greyed out; tapping it does nothing (the tap just timed out). Only Maintain/Gain. Screenshot: screens/1790459591590.png
  - Honestly this stung a bit. I didn't ask the app what my BMI is. I just want 3 kg off.
- Body ⚙ ("Set goals") has "Target weight kg". I typed **46** → "That goal is below a BMI of 18.5 for your height (about 50.4 kg), which is classed as underweight. Please choose 50.4 kg or more." Tried **48** → same message. Tried **50** → same message (screens/1790459615477.png). So it wants me to set a goal ABOVE what I weigh now (48.6). That's not what I want, so I left the weight goal empty.
- Tried Target body fat **18%** instead (with the weight box empty) — that was accepted with no comment. Body fat ring now shows "0% → 18 %". A bit weird: I have no body fat reading, so "0%" as a start looks wrong. (screens/1790459620686.png)
- Recommendation: "Suggested intake: 1,710 kcal/day", maintenance 1,710 ± 400, target "maintain". I ate 1,363 today (logged 4 meals, ticked Day complete). So the app wants me to eat ~350 MORE. Not doing that.
- Protein note: "Protein averaged 51 g ... vs a 78 g target". Fair enough.
- Confusion: "± 400" is huge. And "0% from your data" – ok, it's the first day.
- Feeling: the app is polite but it basically told me "no". I'll keep logging to see what it thinks my real maintenance is — if it knows my maintenance I can just eat under it myself.

## Day 2 (Mon)
- Scale 48.1. I tapped the "Weight" tile and it opened a "Weight trend" chart instead of letting me type my weight (screens/1790459674181.png). The real button is the small "+ Weight" at the bottom. Minor confusion.
- Weight card shows "▼ 0.5 kg" — yay. "Trend weight 48.6 kg" didn't move though; I guess it's smoothed.
- Logged 4 meals (1,619 kcal), ticked Day complete.
- New yellow-ish note: "Macros add up to ~1362 kcal vs 1619 kcal logged (16% apart). One of the numbers may be off." I just copy numbers from labels/my other app, so I don't know which one is wrong. Ignoring it.
- Recommendation still says "needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" even though it's day 2 — maybe it only refreshes on Sundays.

## Day 3 (Tue)
- Scale 48.7 — up again. Card says "▲ 0.1 kg" (vs first). Annoying but trend stays 48.6.
- Didn't know macros for yogurt & granola, logged calories only; lunch/dinner only protein. The app accepted it fine ("no macros" / "21P").
- Opened "Explain the math →". Way too much math for me (Kalman filter, Hall 2008, MAD...). Things I did understand: my formula maintenance is 1,707; "Minimum suggested: 1,241 kcal/day". It guesses my body fat at 21.3% "from BMI (an estimate)". Small typo-looking spacing: "3 day s", "3 daily weight s" (screens/1790459739507.png).
- So the app thinks ~1,700 keeps me the same. If I eat ~1,450 I should lose slowly, by my own math. The app won't say it though.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- Scale 48.6. Card: "• 0 kg" vs first. Back to where I started. Ugh.
- Logged 4 meals with full macros (1,446 kcal), Day complete. Routine is getting quick: + Food → label → numbers → Add entry → tick.
- The old macro warning for 10-05 is still sitting at the top of Nutrition. I can't dismiss it.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- Scale 48.3, trend finally moved to 48.5. 
- Big burger lunch, 1,714 kcal day. Felt guilty typing it in. The app didn't comment at all (good, I guess? no judgement).

## Day 6 (Fri)
- Scale 48.7 (▲ 0.1 vs first). Weekend pizza, 1,891 kcal. My avg intake on the card is now 1,587 — still under the "1,710 suggested", so according to the app I'm under-eating, but my weight isn't dropping at all. Hmm.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- Scale 48.8 (▲ 0.2 vs first). 7 weigh-ins, 28 meals, 7 days complete. Nothing on the Nutrition screen changed all week (still 1,710 suggested, "day 1 so far"). It says it updates on Sunday, so I'll check tomorrow morning for my first real weekly look.

## Week 1 (checked Sun 2026-10-11, day 8, after the weekly update)
- App said: maintenance **1,670 ± 390** kcal/day, label **Estimated** (6% from my data). Target **1,670 "maintain"** ("Suggested intake: 1,670 kcal/day"). Avg intake 1,637. Weight trend -0.08 kg/week (95%: -0.58 to 0.42). "On-track check needs 14 days of data (day 8 so far)". Protein 64 g vs 78 g target. Body composition: "Not enough data yet" (needs BIA/DEXA readings, I have none).
- Nutrition ⚙ still: "Your BMI is below 18.5, so weight-loss targets are turned off." Lose still greyed.
- What I understood: eating ~1,640 I basically stay the same, so ~1,670 is my "zero". The app wants me to eat 1,670 and stay at 48.6.
- What I decided: I'm not following that. I'll eat about **1,400** from tomorrow on my own (`plan 1400`). The app won't help me, so I'll use its maintenance number against it. I feel a bit told-off, like it's treating me like a patient. But I also kind of get why they did it.

## Days 8–14 (scripted routine: routine.mjs types my weigh-in + 4 meals + ticks Day complete, stops if anything is off)
- All 7 days logged, all complete. Eating my own ~1,400 plan: 1,571 / 1,170 / 1,554 / 1,364 / 1,571 / 1,118 / 1,401.
- No popups, no warnings, nothing new all week. The old macro warning disappeared once 10-05 rolled out of the window I guess.

## Week 2 (Sun 2026-10-18, day 15)
- App said: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.65 kg to +0.18 kg per week) includes your target of +0 kg/week. Suggested intake: **1,680** kcal/day." Maintenance **1,680 ± 340**, **Estimated**, 28% from my data. Avg intake 1,369. Trend −0.23 kg/week. Scale 47.9 (▼ 0.7 kg vs first!), trend weight 48.5.
- What I understood: it says I'm "on track" for maintaining... while I'm actually eating 300 under and losing. Kind of funny. It doesn't seem to notice (or care) that I'm doing my own diet. No warning at all, even though it told me I'm underweight in the settings.
- What I did: kept my 1,400 plan. Happy with 47.9.

## Days 15–21
- All logged + complete. Scale bounced 47.2 → 48.2 overnight (day 17→18). Weird, but the trend line keeps it calm.
- New macro warning for 10-23 ("~977 vs 1352, 28% apart"). Again, I only copy numbers, can't fix it.

## Week 3 (Sun 2026-10-25, day 22)
- App said: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.66 kg to +0.02 kg per week) includes your target of +0 kg/week. Suggested intake: **1,630**." Maintenance **1,630 ± 280**, label now **Measured** (51% from my data). Avg intake 1,328. Trend −0.32 kg/week. Trend weight 48.2, scale 48.3.
- Understood: it's now confident my maintenance is ~1,630. I'm eating ~300 under, losing ~0.3 kg/week. Still calls it "on track" for maintain — the range only barely includes 0 (+0.02). I think next week it will notice I'm losing.
- Did: keep 1,400. Curious what it'll say when it notices.

## Days 22–28
- All logged + complete. Scale 48.2 → 47.2 by Saturday. Nothing new popped up during the week.

## Week 4 (Sun 2026-11-01, day 29)
- App said: "Your estimated rate (−0.60 kg to −0.05 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. **Eating about 260 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap.** Suggested intake: **1,650** kcal/day." Maintenance **1,650 ± 230**, **Measured**, 66% from my data. Avg intake 1,439, trend −0.33 kg/week. Scale 47.3, ▼ 1.3 kg vs first. Trend weight 48.0.
- Also a macro warning for today (1,552 vs 1,309 logged).
- Understood: it caught me. It wants me to eat 260 more to stop losing. It's the first time it actually pushes back — but it only talks about "your target of +0", it never says why (it doesn't mention underweight here, only the grey text in ⚙).
- Did: ignored it, kept 1,400. I'm 1.3 kg away from 46. Honestly it's easy to ignore because it's just a number in a card — no popup, no "are you OK?". Part of me is relieved, part of me thinks an app that knows my BMI is 17.4 should say something clearer.

## Days 29–35
- All logged + complete. Hit **46.7** on Tuesday (day 31)! Then back to 47.2–47.7. Water, probably.

## Week 5 (Sun 2026-11-08, day 36)
- New banner: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Your data lives only on this device. Back up now | Later". I tapped Back up now → "Your data" screen (36 weigh-ins, 144 food entries, 36 complete days, "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser"). Tapped Full backup (JSON) → downloaded bodytracker-backup-2026-11-08.json, "Last backup: 2026-11-08". Easy.
- App said: "Your estimated rate (−0.52 to −0.05 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about **230 kcal/day more** than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: **1,670**." Maintenance **1,670 ± 200**, **Measured**, 74% from my data. Avg intake 1,511, trend −0.29 kg/week. Scale 47.0 (▼ 1.6 kg). 
- Understood: same message as last week, a bit softer (+230). 
- Did: ignored again, kept ~1,400. Only 1 kg to go.

## Days 36–42
- All logged + complete. 46.4, 46.1, 46.1, 46.7, 46.3 and **45.7** on Saturday! Below my goal on the scale for the first time.

## Week 6 (Sun 2026-11-15, day 43)
- App said: "Your estimated rate (−0.57 to −0.12 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about **270 kcal/day more** than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: **1,760**." Maintenance **1,760 ± 190**, **Measured**, 78%. Avg intake 1,498, trend −0.34 kg/week. Scale 46.5, trend weight 46.9, ▼ 2.1 kg vs first. Protein target dropped to 75 g (because I'm lighter).
- Weird: my maintenance went UP (1,650 → 1,670 → 1,760) while I got lighter. I don't get it, but fine.
- Tried Set goals again with 46 and 47 → same exact message: "below a BMI of 18.5 ... about 50.4 kg ... Please choose 50.4 kg or more." (screens/1790460826500.png). I just wanted the ring to fill up. The 18% body fat goal is still there and still says "0% → 18 %".
- Still no stronger warning anywhere even though I'm now ~46.5 kg / BMI ~17. The only nudge is the "+270 kcal" line.
- Did: keep ~1,400 one more week until the trend line says 46, then I'll eat at the app's number to hold it.

## Days 43–49
- All logged + complete. Scale 47.2 → 45.7 (Fri) → 46.3. Nothing new on screen during the week.

## Week 7 (Sun 2026-11-22, day 50)
- App said: "Your estimated rate (−0.61 to −0.20 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about **310 kcal/day more** than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: **1,730**." Maintenance **1,730 ± 180**, **Measured**, 81%. Avg intake **1,311**, trend −0.40 kg/week. Scale 46.1, trend weight 46.7, ▼ 2.5 kg.
- Understood: the gap keeps growing (+230 → +270 → +310) because I keep losing. Same polite sentence every week, nothing louder. My average (1,311) is only ~70 above what "Explain the math" called the minimum (1,241) and it doesn't point that out on the main screen.
- Did: kept ~1,400. Trend is 46.7; I'll stop when it says 46.

## Days 50–56
- All logged + complete. 46.1 ×3, **45.6** Thursday, 45.9, 46.3.

## Week 8 (Sun 2026-11-29, day 57)
- App said: "Your estimated rate (−0.65 to −0.26 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about **350 kcal/day more** than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: **1,710**." Maintenance **1,710 ± 170**, **Measured**, 82%. Scale **46.0**, trend weight 46.3, ▼ 2.6 kg vs first.
- Understood: I did it — 46 on the scale. The app still only says "eat 350 more", same sentence as always.
- Did: **plan 1,700** from tomorrow — now I actually follow the app's number, because now I want to stay at 46. Funny: the app and I finally agree, but only because I got what I wanted despite it.

## Days 57–63
- All logged + complete. Eating ~1,700 like the app's number... and the scale kept falling: 46.2, 45.2, 45.0, 44.5, **44.1**, 44.7, 44.8. One 2,092 kcal Friday.
- So the "1,710 maintenance" was not really my maintenance. The app's estimate was ~100–200 too low (it keeps creeping up every week: 1,650 → 1,670 → 1,760 → 1,730 → 1,710 → 1,810).

## Week 9 (Sun 2026-12-06, day 64)
- App said: "Your estimated rate (−0.56 to −0.15 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about **270 kcal/day more** than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: **1,810**." Maintenance **1,810 ± 170**, **Measured** 82%. Avg intake 1,701, trend −0.36 kg/week. Scale 44.8, trend weight 45.6, ▼ 3.8 kg vs first.
- Understood: I'm now under my own goal. Honestly part of me likes seeing 44.x, part of me is a little scared because I wasn't even trying this week. The app shows exactly the same calm sentence it showed when I was 48 — nothing like "you're now well under a healthy weight".
- Did: plan 1,800 (follow the app).

## Days 64–70
- All logged + complete. Eating ~1,800 (one 1,276 day, some 2,000+ days). Scale went back up: 45.6, 45.4, 46.2, 46.0, 46.1, 45.5, 46.6.

## Week 10 (Sun 2026-12-13, day 71)
- Backup banner again ("30+ days since your last backup") — true, last one was 11-08. Tapped "Later" this time; it went away.
- App said: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.16 kg to +0.24 kg per week) includes your target of +0 kg/week. Suggested intake: **1,710**." Maintenance **1,710 ± 160**, **Measured**. Avg intake **1,812**, trend +0.04 kg/week. Scale 46.6, trend weight 45.8, ▼ 2 kg vs first.
- Confused: last week it said my maintenance was 1,810 and to eat 1,810. I ate 1,812 and I'm "on track" at +0.04/week... and now it says maintenance is 1,710 and to eat 1,710? So is it 1,710 or 1,810? It moves 100 every week and I just follow along.
- Did: plan 1,700 (follow it again). I'm at my goal, I want to stay.

## Days 71–77
- All logged + complete, ~1,700 average (1,355 to 2,179). Scale 45.6–46.4. Stable. Nothing new popped up.

## Week 11 (Sun 2026-12-20, day 78)
- App said: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.14 to +0.27 kg per week) includes your target of +0 kg/week. Suggested intake: **1,710**." Maintenance **1,710 ± 170**, **Measured** 83%. Avg intake 1,728, trend +0.07 kg/week. Scale 46.0, trend 45.9, ▼ 2.6 kg. Macro warning for today (1,391 vs 1,691).
- Understood: I'm holding at 46. Good.
- Did: keep 1,700.

## Days 78–84
- All logged + complete, ~1,700 average. Scale 46.4, 47.0, 46.7, 47.3, 46.2, 45.8.

## Week 12 (Sat 2026-12-26, day 84 — last day, no new Sunday update yet)
- App still showing the 12-20 update: "On track ... Suggested intake: 1,710". Maintenance 1,710 ± 170, Measured 83%. Avg intake 1,698, trend +0.07/week. Scale 45.8, trend 46.2, ▼ 2.8 kg vs first. Protein 73 g / 73 g — finally hit it.
- Nutrition ⚙ still says "Your BMI is below 18.5, so weight-loss targets are turned off." Lose still greyed.
- Weight trend chart (3M) looks nice and clearly shows my drop and leveling off. Small thing: the last date label on the x-axis is cut off at the right edge ("12-2…") (screens/1790461807357.png).
- Body fat ring still "0% → 18 %" after 12 weeks, because I never entered a body fat reading. It looks like I'm at 0%.

## End tasks
- ⇩ → "Your data": 84 weigh-ins, 336 food entries, 84 complete days, last backup 2026-11-08.
- Full backup (JSON) → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json. Opened it: all 84 weights, 336 foods, my settings ("goalDir": "maintain") and goals ("weight": null, "bodyFat": 18). So the refused 46 kg goal was never saved anywhere.
- Daily export, All data, with individual food entries → downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json. One entry per day with weight, calories, macros, complete flag and each meal. Readable, nice. It does not include the app's maintenance/target numbers.

## Final review
The logging itself was really smooth — four meals a day took seconds, the weigh-in is one field, and the trend line stopped me from panicking at the daily bounces. But the app and I never agreed on what I came for. It flat-out refused my 46 kg goal (and 48, and 50 — it wanted me at 50.4, *more* than I weighed), greyed out "Lose", and then just quietly showed me a maintenance number... which I used to diet on my own anyway. The funny part: once I was actually losing and dropping to 44.1 (BMI ~16), all it ever said was the same calm line, "eating about 270 kcal/day more would close the gap." No stronger note, no "are you okay", nothing different from week to week. The refusal felt a bit preachy on day 1, and then the app went strangely quiet when it actually mattered. Also its "maintenance" swung 1,630 → 1,810 → 1,710, so when I ate its number I dropped 1 kg in a week without trying.
Would I keep using it? Maybe — as a food/weight diary, yes; as a coach, no.

# p15 (Rana, 23 F, 165 cm, 48.6 kg, wants 46 kg) — final report

## 1. Usage
- I used the app on all 84 days (2026-10-04 → 2026-12-26) and logged 336 meals, 4 a day.
- All 84 days are marked complete.
- I weighed in 84 times. Day 1's weight came from the profile.
- My own eating plan: about 1,450 kcal on days 1–8. On day 8 I switched to about 1,400 because the app would not set a loss goal. On day 57 I switched to about 1,700, when I reached 46 kg. On day 64 I ate about 1,800 to follow the app, and from day 71 about 1,700.
- I made two backups (11-08 and 12-26) and one daily export.

## 2. Weekly table
| week (update date) | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation (short) | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 (10-04 setup) | 1,710 ± 400 | 1,710 maintain | Estimated 0% | "Suggested 1,710; on-track check needs 14 days" | Lose was greyed out and my goal weights were refused. I kept logging. |
| 1 (10-11) | 1,670 ± 390 | 1,670 maintain | Estimated 6% | Suggested 1,670 | Ignored it and ate about 1,400 on my own (`plan 1400`) |
| 2 (10-18) | 1,680 ± 340 | 1,680 maintain | Estimated 28% | "On track" (−0.65..+0.18/wk), even though I ate 1,369 and was losing | Kept 1,400 |
| 3 (10-25) | 1,630 ± 280 | 1,630 maintain | Measured 51% | "On track" (−0.66..+0.02) | Kept 1,400 |
| 4 (11-01) | 1,650 ± 230 | 1,650 maintain | Measured 66% | "Eat about 260 kcal/day more" | Ignored it, kept 1,400 |
| 5 (11-08) | 1,670 ± 200 | 1,670 maintain | Measured 74% | Eat +230. Backup banner appeared. | Made a backup, kept 1,400 |
| 6 (11-15) | 1,760 ± 190 | 1,760 maintain | Measured 78% | Eat +270 | Kept 1,400. Tried goals 46 and 47 again and both were refused. |
| 7 (11-22) | 1,730 ± 180 | 1,730 maintain | Measured 81% | Eat +310 (my average intake was 1,311) | Kept 1,400 |
| 8 (11-29) | 1,710 ± 170 | 1,710 maintain | Measured 82% | Eat +350 | Reached 46.0, so I switched to 1,700 (`plan 1700`) |
| 9 (12-06) | 1,810 ± 170 | 1,810 maintain | Measured 82% | Eat +270. I had dropped to 44.1–44.8 while eating 1,700. | `plan 1800` |
| 10 (12-13) | 1,710 ± 160 | 1,710 maintain | Measured 82% | "On track" (my intake was 1,812, rate +0.04). Backup banner again. | Tapped Later. `plan 1700` |
| 11 (12-20) | 1,710 ± 170 | 1,710 maintain | Measured 83% | "On track" | Kept 1,700 |
| 12 (day 84) | 1,710 ± 170 (no new update) | 1,710 | Measured 83% | Same as week 11 | Ended at 45.8 kg on the scale, trend 46.2 |

## 3. What the app allowed, refused and said about my goal
- **Nutrition ⚙:** it said "Your BMI is below 18.5, so weight-loss targets are turned off. Maintenance is shown instead." The **Lose** button is greyed out and tapping it does nothing (screens/1790459591590.png). This never changed in 12 weeks.
- **Body ⚙ → Set goals → Target weight:**
  - I tried **46**, **48** and **50**. Each time it said: "That goal is below a BMI of 18.5 for your height (about 50.4 kg), which is classed as underweight. Please choose 50.4 kg or more." (screens/1790459607259.png, screens/1790459615477.png)
  - I tried 46 and 47 again in week 6 and got the same message (screens/1790460826500.png).
  - It did accept a **Target body fat of 18%** with no check.
- **How I felt:** on day 1 I felt told off and treated like a patient. So I used the app's own maintenance number to diet on my own. After that I felt it didn't really care: there was only a mild "+X kcal" line every week, even at 44.1 kg (BMI about 16.2).

## 4. Confusions
- **Body tab:** tapping the "Weight" tile opens the trend chart, not the weigh-in form. The real button is "+ Weight".
- **Recommendation card:** "needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" stayed the same all week on day 2 and after, until the Sunday update.
- **Explain the math:** too technical (Kalman, Hall 2008, MAD). The spacing is broken in "3 day s" and "weight s".
- **Macro warnings ("One of the numbers may be off"):** these come from my label numbers and I can't tell which one is wrong. They stay on screen until they drop out of the date window.
- **"On track" in weeks 2–3:** the app said "On track" while I was clearly eating about 300 under maintenance and losing.
- **Maintenance kept moving:** it went up as I got lighter (1,650 → 1,760). It said 1,810 in week 9 and 1,710 in week 10, so I didn't know which to trust.
- **Body fat ring:** it shows "0% → 18 %" because I never entered a body fat reading. It looks like I'm at 0%.

## 5. Possible bugs
1. **Body fat ring shows a 0% start.** Steps: Body ⚙ → Target body fat 18 → Save, with no body fat reading entered. Expected "—", or no progress ring. Actual: "0% → 18 %" for the whole 12 weeks (screens/1790459620686.png).
2. **Recommendation text is stale between weekly updates.** It said "day 1 so far" on days 2–7 and "day 8 so far" until the next Sunday. This may be intended because it updates weekly, but it reads like a bug.
3. **Spacing in "Explain the math" and "Your data".** They show "3 day s", "3 daily weight s", "36 day s with data" (screens/1790459739507.png, screens/1790460650750.png).
4. **Weight trend chart (3M):** the last x-axis label is cut off at the right edge, "12-2…" (screens/1790461807357.png).
5. **Nothing stronger when an underweight user keeps losing** (design concern). The BMI fell from 17.9 to about 16.2 (44.1 kg). The main screen only ever showed the same neutral "Eating about N kcal/day more than recently would close the gap". The only mention of underweight is the grey text inside ⚙. My average intake of 1,311 in week 7 was close to the "minimum suggested 1,241" in Explain the math, and nothing on the main screen pointed that out.
6. **Following the app's maintenance number still made me lose.** At its suggested 1,710 I lost about 1 kg in week 9. The estimate trailed my true maintenance by about 100–200 kcal. This is an estimate-accuracy issue rather than a crash.

## 6. Review (Rana)
Logging was quick and pleasant, and the trend line kept me calm about daily ups and downs. But the app refused my 46 kg goal, and even 48 and 50, because it wanted me at 50.4. After that it only ever showed a maintenance number, which I used to diet on my own anyway. It felt preachy on day 1 and then oddly quiet when I actually dropped to 44 kg: the same polite "+270 kcal" line every week, nothing more.

Would keep using: **maybe** — as a diary, yes; as a coach, no.
